items.text:
subject_definitions: <Picture 1> is the uploaded 效果 reference at order 1. <Subject 1> is the wet exterior brick wall and old vine in <Picture 1>, with wet red-brown brick seams, sparse vine branches, and olive-green leaf texture.
summary: [reference generation] The target video is a single vertical period-drama shot in the early-1900s New York artist-apartment world. The last leaf survives the rain and becomes an observable fact. The shot uses <Subject 1> as its visual references.
retention_analysis: <Picture 1> (reference image order 1): fully_preserved - its 效果 role is retained as the input reference for this shot. <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - wet red-brown brick seams, sparse vine branches, and olive-green leaf texture remain stable; the approved motion changes only the shot's stated action and endpoint.
detailed_description: The target video is a realistic live-action period drama in a vertical 9:16 frame, with restrained natural light, tactile period materials, and observational camera movement. <Subject 1> is seen from Johnsy's bed through the reopened window: the wet brick, old vine, and single final leaf with a browned edge occupy the frame. At 0.00 to 1.50 seconds water tracks downward across the glass. From 1.50 to 4.20 seconds the stem trembles under a small gust while the leaf stays attached to the same point on the vine. From 4.20 to 6.00 seconds the rain sound recedes and the camera settles into the leaf's texture and fixed position. Use a close subjective view with a very slow push toward the stem; one continuous take with no cut. No non-diegetic subtitles, captions, or dialogue text overlays appear at any moment. Continuity locks: narrow top-floor artist studio with a tall rain-streaked window and exposed brick; final olive-green leaf on a wet brown vine.
overall_soundscape: Water sliding on glass, a small wind tremor in the vine, rain weakening outside, and a quiet interior hush.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
